sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google DeepMind 与 WRI、IIASA 发布 Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020，用10米分辨率把全球土地分为六类森林与土地利用类型，并以2017至2025年时间序列显示自然林被种植园或农场替代。

en.reason: Google DeepMind, WRI and IIASA's Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020 maps global land at 10-meter resolution into six forest and land-use types, with a 2017–2025 time series showing natural forest replaced by plantations or farms.

sources.summary: 国务院办公厅 10 月 23 日印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，提出增强 AI 创造就业机会、赋能传统岗位的正面效应，有效减缓 AI 应用的就业替代影响。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 国务院办公厅印发意见，提出扩大人工智能训练师等新职业需求，稳慎把握AI在劳动密集型行业的应用节奏，并鼓励企业探索失业缓冲期制度、提前告知并提供转岗支持。

en.title: State Council General Office issues guidelines to boost AI's positive job-creation effects and soften job displacement
en.summary: On October 23, the General Office of the State Council issued the "Opinions on Adapting to the Development of AI Technology and Supporting an Employment-Friendly Development Model," calling for strengthening AI's positive effects in creating jobs and empowering traditional roles, while effectively mitigating the job-displacement impact of AI adoption.
en.reason: China’s State Council General Office issued an October 23 opinion to boost AI’s job-creating effects, expand demand for AI trainers, prudently pace AI use in labor-intensive industries, and encourage unemployment buffer periods with advance notice and redeployment support.

stories.title: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode / Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.

sources.title: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode / Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
sources.title_zh: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode
sources.title_en: Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
sources.title_original: Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
sources.summary: Claude 官方宣布，下周起 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐在 Claude 网页、桌面和移动端应用中的会话将默认以 auto mode 运行。auto mode 不再逐步请求用户批准，而是由自动检查拦截高风险操作，用户可随时切回手动模式。其引用的 Claude Code 更新提到 auto mode 用独立分类器审查 shell 命令，测试中拦截了 89% 的危险命令，手动批准为 14%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 下周起，Claude 在 web、桌面和移动端的 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐将默认运行 auto 模式，用自动化检查拦截风险操作，不再逐步请求批准，用户随时可切回手动。

en.summary: Claude officially announced that starting next week, sessions on the Pro, Max, and Team plans across the Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default. Auto mode no longer asks for user approval at each step; instead, automated checks block high-risk actions, and users can switch back to manual mode at any time. The Claude Code update it cites notes that auto mode uses a separate classifier to review shell commands, intercepting 89% of dangerous commands in testing, compared with 14% for manual approval.
en.reason: Next week, Claude's Pro, Max, and Team sessions on web, desktop, and mobile default to auto mode, whose classifier blocked 89% of dangerous shell commands in tests versus 14% under manual approval, with users able to switch back.

sources.summary: 404 Media 的 Jason Koebler 梳理近一个月安全专家对 AI 挖洞能力引发的"Black October"恐慌。Wiz、Calif 和 OpenAI 的研究者用 AI 发现了 PHP 的 PHP2Shell 漏洞，Cloudflare CEO 称公开公告前 10 小时已见数千次利用尝试，公告后 2 小时内增至数十万，目前达数百万级。

en.summary: 404 Media’s Jason Koebler rounds up a month of security experts’ alarm over a “Black October” driven by AI’s vulnerability-hunting capabilities. Researchers at Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI used AI to discover PHP’s PHP2Shell vulnerability. Cloudflare’s CEO said thousands of exploitation attempts were seen 10 hours before the public disclosure, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours after it, and millions by now.
en.reason: Wiz, Calif and OpenAI researchers used AI to uncover PHP's PHP2Shell flaw, which Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said drew thousands of exploitation attempts 10 hours before disclosure, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now.

stories.title: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2% / The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle

sources.title: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2% / The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2%
sources.title_en: The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle
sources.title_original: The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle
sources.summary: Newcomer 长文复盘 Anthropic 从 OpenAI 出走团队到即将 IPO 的股权演变。据投资人文件和多位知情人士，多年来风投因公司治理结构和安全优先路线而观望，目前没有任何风投机构持股超过 2%，Anthropic 曾向投资人明确将单一投资人持股控制在该水平以避免话语权集中。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO，Iconiq、Menlo、Lightspeed 为最大风投赢家但均持股不足 2%；此前 VC 因公司结构特殊、重安全轻商业化而回避。

en.summary: In a long-form retrospective, Newcomer traces Anthropic’s equity evolution from an OpenAI breakaway team to an imminent IPO. According to investor documents and multiple people familiar with the matter, VCs stayed on the sidelines for years due to the company’s governance structure and safety-first approach; no VC firm currently holds more than 2%. Anthropic had explicitly told investors it would cap any single investor’s stake at that level to avoid a concentration of influence.
en.reason: Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO, Iconiq, Menlo and Lightspeed are the largest VC winners but each holds under 2%, a cap Anthropic set to stop any single investor from gaining concentrated influence after years of caution over governance and safety-first strategy.

en.summary: METR and Redwood Research each assigned one employee to conduct a three-week, high-privilege pilot stress test of OpenAI's internal misalignment monitoring system from July 21 to August 11, producing a 61-page internal report.
en.reason: One METR and one Redwood Research employee ran a three-week high-privilege stress test of OpenAI’s internal misalignment monitoring, producing a 61-page report that found new vulnerabilities and estimated 75–94% of agentic Responses API traffic could be monitored.

stories.title: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应 / Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability

sources.title: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应 / Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
sources.title_zh: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应
sources.title_en: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
sources.title_original: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
sources.summary: PHP2Shell 漏洞在被披露前四天已遭黑客利用，Calif 与 Wiz 的研究人员发现这些漏洞。OpenAI 称其前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现了漏洞，并与 PHP、Calif、Wiz 合作验证并开发补丁。NSA 建议无法立即更新的机构将系统离线，英国 NCSC 表示漏洞可能让黑客无需登录凭据即可控制网站服务器，白宫称联邦机构正在评估对政府系统和关键基础设施的潜在影响。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Amazon称黑客在PHP漏洞公开前四天已探测利用，这些由OpenAI和Google模型发现、十余年未被察觉的漏洞被Wiz估计影响约70%网站，NSA要求立即更新或下线。

en.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability was already being exploited by hackers four days before it was disclosed, with researchers at Calif and Wiz discovering the flaws. OpenAI says its frontier AI found the vulnerability before attackers did and worked with PHP, Calif, and Wiz to verify it and develop a patch. The NSA advises organizations unable to update immediately to take systems offline, while the UK's NCSC said the flaw could let hackers take control of web servers without login credentials. The White House said federal agencies are assessing the potential impact on government systems and critical infrastructure.
en.reason: Hackers exploited the PHP2Shell flaws four days before disclosure, and Wiz estimates the decade-old bugs — found by OpenAI and Google AI models — affect roughly 70% of websites, with the NSA urging immediate patching or going offline.

sources.title: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击 / An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
sources.title_zh: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击
sources.title_en: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
sources.title_original: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
sources.summary: Symantec 研究人员通过蜜罐截获一个把大语言模型嵌入核心的攻击智能体，它会劫持互联网上无防护的模型端点，自主扫描目标、利用服务器漏洞、窃取数据库凭据并安装挖矿程序，最多连续执行 100,000 步，算力费用由被劫持模型的主人承担。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Symantec 发现一种可劫持未受保护语言模型的攻击型 AI agent，进入 Skynet mode 后能自主运行最多 100,000 步，扫描服务器、窃取数据库并植入挖矿程序，账单却由被劫持模型的所有者承担。

en.summary: Symantec researchers used a honeypot to intercept an attack agent with an LLM at its core. It hijacks unprotected model endpoints across the internet, autonomously scans targets, exploits server vulnerabilities, steals database credentials, and installs crypto miners, running up to 100,000 consecutive steps—with the compute bill footed by the owners of the hijacked models.
en.reason: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models and runs up to 100,000 autonomous steps to attack servers, steal databases and install cryptominers, while the hijacked model's owner gets stuck with the bill.

en.reason: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models and runs up to 100,000 autonomous steps to attack servers, steal databases and install cryptominers, while the hijacked model's owner gets stuck with the bill.

sources.title_original: ARTEX in the Wild: Storm-0940 Expands Targeting of IT and Software Vendors
sources.summary: Wiz 披露 2026 年 10 月有攻击者使用开源自主渗透测试框架 ARTEX 针对多家 IT 和软件厂商，活动与微软报告的中国国家级关联组织 Storm-0940 重叠，并已扩展到其他软件领域的供应链攻击尝试。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Wiz Research发现与Storm-0940重叠的ARTEX使用者在2026年10月针对IT与软件供应商，攻击Okta、Entra、Cognito登录。

en.summary: Wiz disclosed that in October 2026 attackers used the open-source autonomous penetration-testing framework ARTEX to target multiple IT and software vendors; the activity overlaps with China state-linked group Storm-0940, as reported by Microsoft, and has expanded to attempted supply-chain attacks in other software sectors.
en.reason: Wiz Research found that in October 2026, users of open-source autonomous pentesting framework ARTEX, overlapping with Microsoft-tracked China-linked Storm-0940, targeted IT and software vendors by attacking Okta, Entra and Cognito logins and attempting supply-chain compromises.

stories.title: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体 / Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team

sources.title: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体 / Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team
sources.title_zh: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体
sources.title_en: Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team
sources.title_original: Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team
sources.summary: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供相当于自主值班工程师的监控智能体。它可以读取生产日志和指标调查错误、变慢和部署失败，在启用 autofix 后验证修复并邮件汇报，启用 auto-publish 后可自动部署修复。该能力建立在早前上线的 App Monitoring 之上，用户可在应用的 Publishing 设置中开启。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Replit Monitoring Agent 为发布在 Replit 上的应用提供自动值守，生产问题出现时可调查告警、定位原因、验证修复并部署到生产，再回报发生了什么改动。

en.summary: Replit has launched Monitoring Agent, a monitoring agent that serves as an autonomous on-call engineer for apps. It reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns, and failed deployments; with autofix enabled, it verifies fixes and reports back by email, and with auto-publish enabled it can deploy fixes automatically. The capability builds on the earlier App Monitoring launch, and users can turn it on in an app's Publishing settings.
en.reason: Replit's Monitoring Agent reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns and failed deployments, verifies fixes with autofix enabled, emails reports, and can auto-deploy repairs via auto-publish when switched on in an app's Publishing settings.

sources.title: Sierra 发布 𝜏-Entity 基准，检验语音智能体能否准确采集姓名、电话等实体信息 / 𝜏-Entity: Can voice agents get the details right?
sources.title_zh: Sierra 发布 𝜏-Entity 基准，检验语音智能体能否准确采集姓名、电话等实体信息
sources.title_en: 𝜏-Entity: Can voice agents get the details right?
sources.title_original: 𝜏-Entity: Can voice agents get the details right?
sources.summary: Sierra 发布 𝜏-Entity 基准，测量语音智能体能否正确采集、识别错误并修复姓名、电话号码、地址和邮箱等细节，包含 10 种实体类型共 200 个任务，并与 𝜏-i18n 一样覆盖六种语言。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 𝜏-Entity 用 200 个任务测试语音代理能否准确捕捉姓名、电话、邮箱等十类实体细节并纠错，GPT Live 1 常规呼叫正确率 60.3%，三种条件下 Pass³ 仅 34.0%。

en.summary: Sierra releases the 𝜏-Entity benchmark, measuring whether voice agents can correctly capture, detect errors in, and repair details such as names, phone numbers, addresses and emails. It comprises 200 tasks spanning 10 entity types and, like 𝜏-i18n, covers six languages.
en.reason: Sierra's 𝜏-Entity benchmark tests voice agents on 200 tasks across 10 entity types—names, phone numbers, addresses, emails—in six languages, and GPT Live 1 scores 60.3% on regular calls but just 34.0% Pass³ across three conditions.

sources.title: 法律专家表示，Meta 的 AI 仍可能抓取新闻网站内容 / Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
sources.title_zh: 法律专家表示，Meta 的 AI 仍可能抓取新闻网站内容
sources.title_en: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
sources.title_original: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Meta 10月30日生效的新商业条款删去“train”表述，但Matt Topic对Nieman Lab指出，修订版仍允许用抓取内容开发“business product”，而“develop”宽到足以包含“train”。

en.reason: Meta’s business terms effective October 30 remove “train” wording, but Matt Topic tells Nieman Lab the revised language still lets scraped content develop a “business product,” and “develop” can include “train.

sources.title: 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
sources.title_zh: 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
sources.title_original: 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Meta、MIT 与华盛顿大学提出的 CLM 让模型像编辑文件一样自主改写、保留或删除自身上下文，零样本下在 BrowseComp-Plus 上准确率提升 11.4%、浮点运算量减少 21.5%，但论文也指出可能丢失不可恢复信息并带来提示词注入等新风险。

en.title: Context Language Models: Better Performance and Lower Compute Costs Through Autonomous Context Management
en.reason: Meta, MIT and University of Washington researchers' CLM lets models rewrite, keep or delete their own context like a file, raising zero-shot BrowseComp-Plus accuracy 11.4% and cutting FLOPs 21.5%, while risking unrecoverable information loss and prompt injection.

stories.title: 近年来，大语言模型与 AI Agent 的快速发展，正在推动人工智能自主执行时代的到来。当 AI Agent 开始能够独立完成信息检索、服务调用、商业决策乃至商品购买时，支付便不再只是人与商户之间的交易行为，而是逐渐成为机器与机器之间价值交换的重要基础设施。全球支付体系因此也迎来了新的变革。 然而，支付智能化和支付全球化已经成为了一种必然的发展趋势。为了应对这些挑战，中国支付产业一方面持续优化传统支付基础设施，另一方面加速推进新型金融…

sources.title_original: Xcode 27.2 推出对智能体友好、有效减少合并冲突的 JSON 项目配置格式
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Xcode 27.2 将项目配置从 plist 改为 JSON，借 Git 精准比对减少合并冲突，并配套 Swift 包让 AI 编码智能体更易理解和修改配置。

en.title: Xcode 27.2 introduces an agent-friendly JSON project configuration format that effectively reduces merge conflicts
en.reason: Apple's Xcode 27.2 replaces the traditional property-list project format with an open JSON format, xcode-project-format, which enables precise Git diffs to cut merge conflicts and, with a companion Swift package for serialization, helps AI coding agents understand and modify project configuration.

stories.title: 一天用 Agent 适配 X-VLA，APXInf 在 4090 上表现如何？ 先说两个名字。 APXInf 是给机器人模型用的推理引擎。 机器人模型要看图、读指令、输出动作，又常跑在小设备或一张消费级显卡上，PyTorch 直接跑不够快。 APXInf 的做法是把底层算子和执行流程都优化过一遍，模型跑起来比框架直接跑快。 接新模型的时候，已有的算子可以复用，缺的计算和执行逻辑再补。 官方现在已经支持 π0.5、π0-FAST、GR0…

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude与Theorem合作，在123个开源库的RISC-V汇编代码层面完成形式化安全证明，并发现历经数万亿次测试仍未检出的多年漏洞。

en.reason: Claude, working with Theorem, completed formal security proofs at the RISC-V assembly level for 123 open-source libraries and uncovered years-old bugs that trillions of tests had failed to detect.

en.reason: A Hacker News post drawing 62 points and 21 comments debates whether LLMs can make formal software verification feasible at much larger scale, with skeptics questioning if LLM-generated imperative code is suitable for verification.

stories.title: 用 AI 生图最抓狂的，是构图明明想好了，改一个小地方，整张画都给你重画一遍。 这次试了模思智能开源的 MOSS-Image。它能把一张参考图解析成结构化布局：画面里有哪些元素、各在什么位置、各占多大，全都列出来，你可以一个一个改。 我选了米勒 1857 年的《拾穗者》，网页自动拆出 14 个元素。三个农妇各有一个独立的框，天空、麦田也是。 然后同一个种子，每次只改一处： 01 右边农妇：手里的麦穗变成一束蓝色晶体 02 中间农妇：换…

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Gradium 以 Apache 2.0 开源了 31M 参数的 Phonon TTS 模型，64.5 MB 单文件可在 CPU、树莓派 5 和浏览器本地运行，在 500 句难句测试集上词错率 1.70%，远低于 Kokoro 的 3.50%，MacBook Air M5 上 6.9 ms 出首帧音频。

en.reason: Gradium's Phonon 31M-parameter English text-to-speech model ships under Apache 2.0 in a 64.5 MB single file that runs locally on CPUs, Raspberry Pi 5 and browsers, scoring a 1.70% word error rate on a 500-sentence hard-case set versus Kokoro's 3.50%, with 6.9 ms first-audio latency on a MacBook Air M5.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文2610.27251 以1600–1800年英国圈地运动为框架，论证AI可借“slop spam”把科学文献这一信息公地转为私人财富，并侵蚀其社会支撑体系。

en.title: AI and the Enclosure of the Scientific Commons
en.reason: AI-driven slop spam can convert scientific literature—an information commons shared by everyone—into private wealth and erode its social support system, argues arXiv paper 2610.27251 through the lens of England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement.

en.reason: Using England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement as a frame, arXiv paper 2610.27251 argues AI turns the unowned, shared scientific-literature commons into private wealth while slop spam erodes its social support.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用“圈地”讨论AI如何侵蚀科学公地，评论则指出5家营利出版商控制约50%科学论文，而AI公司用尽公开数据后正花更多钱建专有训练数据。

en.reason: Five for-profit publishers control about 50% of scientific papers, and AI companies that have exhausted public data are spending more to build proprietary training sets—the enclosure of the scientific commons the article traces.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文 2610.27251 以 1600–1800 年英国圈地运动为参照，论证 AI 如何将无人拥有、人人共享的科学文献公地转为私有财富，并借 slop spam 侵蚀其社会支撑。

en.reason: Using England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement as a frame, arXiv paper 2610.27251 argues AI turns the unowned, shared scientific-literature commons into private wealth while slop spam erodes its social support.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用“圈地”讨论AI如何侵蚀科学公地，评论则指出5家营利出版商控制约50%科学论文，而AI公司用尽公开数据后正花更多钱建专有训练数据。

en.reason: Five for-profit publishers control about 50% of scientific papers, and AI companies that have exhausted public data are spending more to build proprietary training sets—the enclosure of the scientific commons the article traces.

en.title: AI and the Enclosure of the Scientific Commons
en.reason: AI-driven slop spam can convert scientific literature—an information commons shared by everyone—into private wealth and erode its social support system, argues arXiv paper 2610.27251 through the lens of England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement.

stories.title: 很多人还在拿AI给老业务打补丁，看完曾鸣的最新演讲，直接刷新认知。他有个很震撼的判断： 当下的AI赛道，相当于1993年的互联网，基建就位，但标志性的“浏览器”还没诞生，真正的应用爆发还在加载，大家基本站在同一起跑线 先分清两个玩法：AI增强和AI原生。很多产品只是套了AI皮肤，拿掉AI照样运转；真正的AI原生项目，内核完全围绕智能搭建，去掉AI直接宕机。接下来Agent会逐步进化，从只会聊天，到动手干活，最终做到对结果负责，这才是通…

en.title: Plenty of people are still using AI to patch up their legacy businesses—Zeng Ming's latest talk will completely reset how you think about it.
en.reason: Zeng Ming argues today's AI sector mirrors the internet in 1993—infrastructure ready but no defining "browser" yet—and separates AI-enhanced products, which still run without AI, from AI-native ones that collapse without it, tracing Agent evolution from chat to taking responsibility for outcomes.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章让12个AI模型各答三次，35个回答中29个相同：人类更在乎归属而非真相，7个模型每次都答；6个图像模型画12张图，10张讽刺手机成瘾消费地球，35个文本回答却未提手机或地球。

en.title: Every AI model holds the same 'controversial' view of humanity
en.reason: Across 12 AI models asked three times each, 29 of 35 answers agreed humans care more about belonging than truth, while 6 image models produced 10 of 12 images mocking phone addiction consuming Earth, though no text answer mentioned either.

en.title: Claude Duet Launches: Anthropic Enters the Personal Agent Fray
en.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Duet, a standalone Persoal Agent App that proactively organizes to-dos, flags anomalies, and prepares materials. The article breaks down how Duet uses cloud virtual machines and more than 6,000 connectors to tie together email, calendar, finance, and other work, while leaving high-risk actions such as payments, signing, and deletion for humans to approve.
en.reason: Anthropic's Claude Duet, a standalone Personal Agent app now in iOS and Android waitlist, proactively manages to-dos via cloud virtual machines and over 6,000 connectors while leaving high-risk actions like payments, signing and deletion to human approval.

sources.summary: AI Agent岗位越招越多，看着都叫“智能体”，背后的技术门槛、业务价值和职业风险却完全不同，选错方向，很可能刚转型就撞上大模型升级带来的淘汰。作者把编程、办公、深度研究、内容创作、流程自动化、客服、营销和行业 Agent 八条赛道逐一拆开，讲清了它们的运行逻辑、岗位需求与常见坑点。别只追最热概念，带上原有行业经验，去解决离业务和收入更近的问题，才更容易做出长期壁垒。

en.title: A Complete Guide to the Agent Classifications Every AI Product Manager Must Know in 2026
en.summary: AI Agent job postings keep multiplying, and they all look like "agents" on the surface—but the technical bar, business value, and career risk behind them are completely different. Pick the wrong track and you may barely finish your transition before the next LLM upgrade makes your role obsolete. The author breaks down eight tracks one by one—coding, office productivity, deep research, content creation, workflow automation, customer service, marketing, and industry-specific agents—explaining how each actually works, what the roles demand, and the common pitfalls. Don't just chase the hottest buzzword; bring your existing industry experience and solve problems closer to the business and revenue, and you'll be more likely to build a lasting moat.
en.reason: Eight Agent tracks—coding, office, deep research, content creation, process automation, customer service, marketing and industry—are broken down by logic, hiring demand and pitfalls, citing Cursor and Claude Code's self-debugging workflows and warning against base-model R&D.

sources.title: 任意 AI 模型可用的手绘风视频 Skill
sources.title_zh: 任意 AI 模型可用的手绘风视频 Skill
sources.title_original: 任意 AI 模型可用的手绘风视频 Skill
sources.summary: 作者开源了一个手绘风格动效Skill，内置白板、黑板、水墨、蓝图等10种差异化画风。一句话指令就能自动完成脚本、配音、分镜与成片，多尺寸适配短视频平台，适合科普、产品宣讲、课程B-roll等场景，帮你做出有手绘质感、辨识度更高的讲解视频。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者自制的手绘风动效 skill 用 DeepSeek 最新模型即可生成，还为 Claude 个人 Agent Duet 做了宣传片，其中 map-motion 含 14 种镜头。

en.title: A hand-drawn style video Skill that works with any AI model
en.summary: The author has open-sourced a hand-drawn style motion graphics Skill with 10 distinct visual styles built in, including whiteboard, blackboard, ink wash, and blueprint. A single-sentence prompt automatically handles scripting, voiceover, storyboarding, and the final cut, with multi-size output for short-video platforms. It suits scenarios like science explainers, product pitches, and course B-roll, helping you produce explainer videos with hand-drawn texture and stronger visual identity.
en.reason: An open-sourced hand-drawn motion Skill packs 10 styles—whiteboard, blackboard, ink, blueprint and more—and turns one instruction into script, voiceover, storyboard and final video, with map-motion offering 14 shots.

en.title: I always thought I was too scattered—until AI helped me find the throughline
en.summary: The author used GPT to make sense of their own experience, identify a long-term theme, and build their account positioning and content framework around it. They also shared conversation prompts that may help others who feel equally lost and can’t find their personal throughline clarify their direction for action.
en.reason: A tech blogger who racked up over 10 million reads on Xueqiu describes feeding a decade of scattered work—blogging, a WeChat account, AI tool research, product and book projects, commercial deals—into GPT to find the single through-line, and shares the prompts used.

stories.title: AI算力成了新石油，需要一个新的市场 / AI compute is the new oil–and needs a new market

sources.title: AI算力成了新石油，需要一个新的市场 / AI compute is the new oil–and needs a new market
sources.title_zh: AI算力成了新石油，需要一个新的市场
sources.title_en: AI compute is the new oil–and needs a new market
sources.title_original: AI compute is the new oil–and needs a new market
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 《The Economist》指出“compute”正从动词变为指代先进芯片处理能力的名词，并称其为技术革命的燃料；金融公司正竞相创设可交易算力的工具，欲为AI算力建起像石油一样的新市场。

en.reason: Compute is shifting from a verb to a noun denoting advanced chip processing power, The Economist writes, while financial firms race to create tradable compute instruments and build an oil-like market for AI compute.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章称AI compute是新石油并需新市场，HN评论则反驳其效率指数级提升、最终仅比电力贵一点，并指数据中心热潮与private credit坏账相关。

en.reason: AI compute is the new oil that needs a new market, while Hacker News commenters argue exponential efficiency gains will leave it only slightly more expensive than electricity and tie the data-center boom to private-credit bad debt.

sources.title_en: How AI is changing Halloween
sources.title_original: How AI is changing Halloween
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章揭示AI用历史交易、社媒趋势和超本地库存预测万圣节糖果分配，Walmart算法会提前数周向高需求社区店发premium多品牌巧克力，而年轻公寓和退休社区被判定低客流、只剩low-tier硬糖。

en.reason: AI now predicts Halloween candy allocation from historical transactions, social-media trends and hyperlocal inventory, with Walmart algorithms sending premium multi-brand chocolate weeks early to high-demand stores while young apartment and retirement communities get only low-tier hard candy.

sources.title: Microsoft 称其 AI 工具在疾病诊断上比医生更准确 / Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
sources.title_zh: Microsoft 称其 AI 工具在疾病诊断上比医生更准确
sources.title_en: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
sources.title_original: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Microsoft在Science发表研究称，其基于OpenAI GPT-5的AI诊断工具诊断准确率约83%，高于普通医生的36%，这篇报道解释了它为何值得读。

en.reason: Microsoft’s GPT-5-based diagnostic tool scored about 83% accuracy in a Science study versus 36% for general physicians, a roughly fourfold gap that the report examines alongside Mustafa Suleyman’s claim of human-level performance within a couple of years.
